title: Left earbud stopped charging after 3 days
content: Terrible build quality. The left earbud stopped charging completely after 3 days of use. Case LED flashes red. Replacement request was ignored by seller.

title: Missing tabletop screws and cracked corner
content: Package arrived badly battered. Two main frame bolts are missing and the front edge of the wood tabletop is visibly cracked. Cannot assemble without hardware.

title: Lid seal leaks hot water
content: Extremely unsafe. The silicone lid ring doesn't seal properly and boiling tea leaked all over my car upholstery. Need an immediate replacement or full refund.

title: Spacebar repeats intermittently
content: Typing emails is a nightmare because the spacebar registers duplicate presses constantly. Tried re-seating the switch but defective PCB.

title: Overheating and shutting down
content: The adapter gets alarmingly hot within 10 minutes of plugging in my laptop and cuts power. This feels like a fire hazard. Requesting immediate return label.
